$comment: Optimus metrics the estate can measure itself (founder 2026-11-20: nothing ships without its Optimus metrics). A SHIP-CONTRACT may only name a metric registered here; Greenlane reads it by running `measure` from main, never from what an author says. A measure prints exactly `optimus.<name>=<number>` and needs no cluster or secret.

metrics.name: estate.platform_dirs_never_applied
metrics.description: platform/ kustomize directories that no Flux Kustomization applies (idp#8328)

metrics.name: claims.ship_contract_enforced
metrics.description: 1 when bin/claim-gate refuses a claim with no SHIP-CONTRACT and admits it with one (idp#8350)

metrics.name: estate.zone_a_graph_drain_files
metrics.description: Zone A Mac graph-drain artifacts on main (source + launchd template); decommissioned 2026-11-22, ingestion is Zone B cloud-only (idp#8412)

metrics.name: legion.missions_landed
metrics.description: Conservative count of reachable main agent-sandbox (auto) landings joined by Greenlane-Head to a genuine Run receipt in the exact source commit (Git object or authenticated GitHub API); never a live inference or external effect claim (idp#8283/#8405)

metrics.name: greenlane.cross_main_failure_cap
metrics.description: Independent trusted-main execution of the actual Engine two-main unchanged-head identical-cause suppression, durable restart, changed-head re-admission, and UNKNOWN refusal (#8289); not a claim of external service availability

metrics.name: bootstrap.r2_scoped_failures
metrics.description: Fatal R2 failure points in bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare's DNS/Workers critical path (I-8455 Stage 1: R2 gates only R2); baseline 2 (mint + bucket proof), target 0
